You can probably convert the bèta’s to a place where they can be used in GenomicSEM. 

Now if you are interest in standardized model (and don’t care about the h2 snp) then you can really just treat as continuous I think, it’s only when you need to pick an effective N that I don’t really know what to do as I know no formula for effective N from ordered logistic.

Best,

Michel
